QuestInfo.name: [9th Anniversary Par-tay] Commemorative Maple Tree
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra is planning a fun party to celebrate the 9th Anniversary of MapleStory. Go see if she needs help!
QuestInfo.1: Take the Maple Tree Seedling that Cassandra gave you to Inkie at the 9th Anniversary Commemorative Park, where the party is happening. Use the #rTeleport Rock Cassandra gave you#k to get there easily.
QuestInfo.2: You planted a great-looking Maple Tree in the park.  How about seeing what else Cassandra needs help with?

default.0: Check to make sure you're keeping the Maple Tree Seedling safe in your possession!

npc.0: Go talk to Inkie at the 9th Anniversary Park. You can use the Dimensional Mirror or the Teleport Rock that I gave you.
